review_candidates.description: Can you own a problem end to end? Not escalate it. Not document it and pass it on. Own it until it's solved, the client understands what happened, and it doesn't happen again. If that's how you work, keep reading. We help regulated businesses, fintechs, banks, hospitality brands and global technology companies run their Apple and Windows fleets securely, compliantly, and without drama. Our clients include Revolut, Kroo, and a range of fintechs, funds and global tech companies.They ask hard questions and expect real answers. Most operate under regulatory scrutiny, which means the work is genuinely technical and the standard is genuinely high. We're now building our engineering capability in Poland, and this is one of the first senior hires into that team. The Role You'll work remotely from anywhere in Poland, supporting our UK client base alongside colleagues in London and South Africa. This is a hybrid engineering and security role. You'll design, build and harden the platforms our clients rely on such as identity, endpoint management, network, and the security controls that sit across all of it. You'll also be the person clients speak to directly when something complex needs solving. Day to day, that means: Building and running secure endpoint estates across macOS and Windows, MDM architecture, configuration profiles, compliance baselines, patching and device lifecycle Owning identity and access - SSO, conditional access, MFA, provisioning and deprovisioning workflows, least-privilege design Hardening and defending - endpoint protection, vulnerability management, logging and alerting, and responding when something looks wrong Supporting compliance - helping clients evidence controls for Cyber Essentials, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and their own regulators Automating everything worth automating - if you're doing it by hand twice, you should be scripting it Leading projects from scoping through to delivery, including the client conversations that go with them Working directly with clients - translating technical detail into language a CTO or a compliance officer can act on Who Thrives Here We can teach tooling. We can't teach the things below, so this is the part that matters most. You solve problems, not tickets. When something lands on your desk that nobody has seen before, your instinct is to dig in, not to hand it back. You're comfortable being the person who works it out. You manage yourself. You'll be trusted with your own workload, your own priorities and your own deadlines, and trusted to flag it early when something is going wrong. You talk to clients directly. You can hold a technical conversation with an engineer and a business conversation with a director, and adjust without losing either of them. You write clearly. You don't hide behind jargon. You find a way through. Vendor won't cooperate. Documentation is wrong. The API doesn't do what it says. You've been there, and you got it done anyway. You care that it's right. Not because someone is watching. Because you can't stand shipping something half-finished. What You'll BringEssential Minimum 5 years in a senior technical IT or security engineering role Advanced knowledge of macOS and Microsoft Windows in a business environment Advanced scripting ability - Python, Bash, PowerShell Advanced experience with cloud identity providers (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD) Strong knowledge of MDM platforms (Jamf Pro, Intune; Kandji, Mosyle or FleetDM also welcome) Strong knowledge of Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 administration Solid networking knowledge - routing, firewalls, VPN, Wi-Fi; Meraki experience particularly valued Practical endpoint and infrastructure security experience - hardening, patching, endpoint protection, access control Demonstrable project delivery experience, including client-facing responsibility Fluent spoken and written English, and the confidence to use it with clients daily Legally able to work in Poland Nice to Have Experience in an MSP or consultancy - delivering for multiple clients at pace Exposure to Cyber Essentials, ISO 27001, SOC 2 or similar frameworks Okta Workflows, or comparable identity automation Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible) and CI/CD pipelines EDR/XDR tooling (Jamf Protect, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Microsoft Defender) SIEM, logging and alerting platforms Incident response experience Relevant certifications - Jamf, Okta, Microsoft, CompTIA Security+, or equivalent Working With Us Hours. Monday to Friday, aligned to UK business hours - 10:00 to 19:00 Polish time, with an hour for lunch. Poland is one hour ahead of the UK, so you'll have full overlap with the London team. Remote, properly. Not remote-with-strings. You work from wherever in Poland suits you. Projects. Some are delivered outside business hours or at weekends. These are always planned well in advance and paid on top. Kit. A MacBook Pro, and whatever hardware and software you need to do the job properly. Certifications. We pay for them. Jamf, Okta, Microsoft, security certifications - if it makes you better at the work, we'll fund it. Why This Role Real autonomy. No layers of sign-off. Weekly rhythms, clear priorities, direct communication. Work that's actually interesting. Regulated fintechs, global tech companies, complex Apple and Windows estates and technical challenges that come with them.  A team being built, not inherited. You'll help shape how our Polish capability works, and you'll have direct access to the people making decisions. Growth. We invest in our people. Certifications, new skills, or broader responsibility, there's a clear path for someone who delivers.

create and review 3D models, flat patterns, BOMs, and manufacturing drawings.  - Set and enforce CAD modeling standards, naming conventions, feature suppression strategies, and template libraries.  - Approve final CAD deliverables for prototype release and production release; maintain as‑built documentation.   - Product development lifecycle & project leadership  - Drive design phases: conceptualization, feasibility, prototyping, verification, pilot production, and full-scale production.  - Define design milestones, gate criteria, quality checkpoints, and deliverables (DFMEA, test plans, validation matrices).  - Lead cross-functional Design Reviews (DRs) and Gate Reviews; drive corrective & preventive actions.  - Oversee validation plans: structural testing, fatigue, vibration, thermal, and ingress protection as required.   - Process improvement & systems  - Implement and mature CAD/PDM/PLM workflows (SolidWorks PDM/Manage, Teamcenter, Windchill), change control (ECO), and revision management.  - Champion automation: design tables, macros, templates, configurators, and model-based definition (MBD) where applicable.  - Institutionalize best practices: design reuse libraries, standard parts catalogs, and knowledge-sharing sessions.   - Stakeholder management & reporting - Work closely with Product Management, Manufacturing, Procurement, QA, and Program Management to align schedules, costs, and requirements.  - Produce regular reports on design progress, risks, resource utilization, and cost metrics to senior leadership.  - Represent the design function in supplier selection, audits, and escalation meetings.   Deliverables & success metrics - Deliverables  - Complete CAD packages (models, flat patterns, drawings, BOMs) for prototypes and production.  - DFMEA, tolerance stack-ups, verification & validation plans, prototype test reports.  - Design standard documentation, CAD libraries, and training materials. Preferred / differentiating skills - Certifications: CSWP/CSWE, Six Sigma Green/Black Belt, PMP or equivalent. - Domain experience : Automotive, industrial machinery, telecom enclosures, medical devices, appliances, or defense. - Simulation: Experience with sheet‑metal forming simulation (e.g., AutoForm), FEA for stamped parts, topology optimization. - Tooling & fixtures: Prior experience designing jigs, fixtures, and progressive dies. - Software: Exposure to CAM, nesting software, NestMaster, Lantek, RADAN or similar. - Manufacturing exposure: Experience working with contract manufacturers and international supply chains. review_candidates.description: Position Objective: The Senior Project Manager - Technical Facilities will lead NT's Owner's Engineer oversight and assurance of the contractors' and EPC delivery of the civil, mechanical, and electrical (CME) works across the Client's data center sites, from site acquisition through construction, commissioning, and final handover. This role keeps NT firmly in its consultant and Project Management Consultant (PMC) assurance posture rather than self-performing the works, ensuring compliance with scope, schedule, cost, and quality against the agreed Project Implementation Plan. The ideal candidate brings strong local knowledge of the Syrian market, permitting, and utility connections. Job Description & Responsibilities: The Senior Project Manager - Technical Facilities leads NT's delivery oversight of the CME and MEP workstream across several mission-critical sites and directs the CME Site Managers and Project Managers reporting in. Lead NT's delivery assurance of the EPC contractor CME scope across the assigned sites, without taking on the contractor's self-perform role. Direct and support the CME Site Managers and Project Managers, set priorities, and resolve cross-site conflicts over resources. Maintain the baseline Project Implementation Plan, agree it with the Client, and monitor every site against it through to handover. Manage daily, weekly, and monthly progress reporting against the baseline, flagging problem areas early with actions to close them. Review and challenge EPC and contractor schedules, sequencing, and method statements, raising concerns where the plan misses delivery dates. Review EPC payment applications against measured progress, assess variations and claims, and maintain workstream cost and capital expenditure trend reporting. Maintain the workstream risk register and dependency log, and escalate high-rated risks before they affect the schedule. Oversee the commissioning sequence through Levels L1 to L5, where L5 is the Integrated Systems Test, and verify QA/QC snagging and punch list closure before acceptance. Ensure delivery remains aligned to the Client-designated availability tier (Uptime Institute Tier III or Tier IV per site), raising field deviations through the design-governance route. Monitor HSE compliance across the assigned sites and apply local knowledge of Syrian permitting and utility timelines to keep the plan realistic. Coordinate interfaces between the CME workstream and the design, IT, and facility certification teams to keep handover on track. Prepare clear progress, cost, and risk reports for the Program Manager and support Client and stakeholder reviews. Qualifications & Experience: Bachelor's degree in Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering, or a closely related discipline. Minimum 8 to 10 years of project management experience in construction or technical facility delivery, including data center or mission-critical, MEP-intensive projects with critical power systems. Proven experience leading a portfolio of parallel sites with subordinate site managers and project managers reporting in. Demonstrated experience driving CME or MEP works through Commissioning Levels L1 to L5 to the Integrated Systems Test and live handover. Working knowledge of Uptime Institute Tier classifications, TIA-942, and the facility certification path (Tier Certification of Design Documents and Tier Certification of Constructed Facility). Working command of Primavera P6 and/or Microsoft Project, QA/QC and acceptance processes, risk management, and change control on multi-stakeholder programs. Substantial local knowledge of the Syrian market, permitting, and utility connections; post-conflict or comparable complex-market experience is a strong advantage. Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, current and valid, required. Strong communication and reporting in English; Arabic required or strongly preferred for liaison with contractors, authorities, and site teams.

Coordinate with site execution teams to collect daily progress data, conduct physical measurement verification, and maintain updated measurement sheets. Review and interpret contractual billing clauses, milestone definitions, and item rate structures to ensure accurate and timely billing submissions. Assist in developing and updating the project’s billing plan linked with construction schedules, milestone timelines, and cash flow projections. Reconcile quantities between client-approved GFC drawings, BOQs, and site execution to avoid duplication or shortfall in billing. MIS & Monthly Reporting Collect and consolidate daily, weekly, and monthly progress data from execution, quality, safety, and stores teams, ensuring accuracy and completeness. Prepare DPRs, WPRs, and MPRs in standardized formats, covering physical progress, financial progress, manpower deployment, material consumption, and work front status. Support the planning team in updating construction schedules (Primavera/MS Project) and extract relevant data to reflect in MIS reports. Coordinate with site teams to obtain actual vs. planned progress updates, including milestone achievements, critical activity status, and pending approvals. Develop and maintain structured MIS trackers for material reconciliation, productivity metrics, subcontractor performance, and delay logs. Coordinate with execution teams to forecast short-term and long-term material needs based on the 3-week/1-month lookahead plan and ensure procurement requests (PRs) are raised accordingly. review_candidates.title: EZ Trainee (m/w/d) für Privatwirtschaftsförderung und Finanzsystementwicklung
review_candidates.description: Sie bewerben sich auf das EZ-Traineeprogramm, ein Nachwuchsförderprogramm des Bundesministeriums für wirtschaftliche Zusammenarbeit und Entwicklung (BMZ). Ausgebildet wird für Organisationen der deutschen und multilateralen Entwicklungszusammenarbeit (EZ) . Das Programm wird von der Deutschen Gesellschaft für internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) im Auftrag des BMZ durchgeführt. Im Fokus des Programms stehen die Erweiterung von Managementkompetenzen und der Erwerb von Arbeitserfahrung in Programmbildung und Steuerung der deutschen EZ. Der Aufbau des Programms ermöglicht Ihnen Strukturen, Akteure und Funktionsweisen der EZ in einem Training „on the Job“ aus verschiedenen Perspektiven kennenzulernen. Während der 17-monatigen Ausbildung durchlaufen Sie drei Praxisphasen . Nach der 1-monatigen Vorbereitung starten Sie mit dem 8-monatigen Einsatz in der o.g. Funktion und dem genannten Land. Anschließend wählen Sie einen 3-monatigen Einsatz bei einer internationalen Organisation und enden mit einem 5-monatigen Einsatz im BMZ. Die Traineevergütung beträgt 2.600,- € brutto/Monat. Weitere Informationen zum EZ-Traineeprogramm finden Sie auf den Internetseiten des BMZ und der GIZ Tätigkeitsbereich Im Rahmen des Traineeprogramms werden Sie für Ihren 8-monatigen Einsatz im GIZ Vorhaben Invest in Senegal, Dakar eingesetzt. Das Vorhaben zielt darauf ab, das Wachstum und die Investitionstätigkeit von senegalesischen und in Senegal tätigen europäischen Unternehmen zu erhöhen. Dazu werden konkrete Unternehmenspartnerschaften zwischen senegalesischen und deutschen und europäischen Unternehmen umgesetzt und eine Servicestelle Wirtschaft als zentrale Anlaufstelle für deutsche/europäische Unternehmen in Senegal etabliert. Lokale kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU) mit Wachstumspotenzial werden in strategischen Wertschöpfungsketten unterstützt, um ihre Wettbewerbsfähigkeit zu erhöhen, lokale Zulieferketten zu stärken und die Einbindung lokaler KMU in nationale und internationale Märkte zu stärken. Zudem legt das Vorhaben einen besonderen Fokus auf den Zugang zu Finanzierung für KMU. Hierzu werden KMU bei der Vorbereitung und Beantragung geeigneter Finanzierungsinstrumente unterstützt und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Beratungs- und Finanzinstitutionen gestärkt. Die Online Plattform Guichet Unique de Financement des PME (GUF-PME) dient dabei als zentrales Instrument, um KMU bedarfsgerecht mit Beratungs- und Finanzierungsangeboten zu vernetzen, Finanzierungsanfragen an geeignete Finanzinstitutionen zu vermitteln und den Finanzierungsprozess effizienter zu gestalten. Der EZ-Traineeeinsatz ist in allen Komponenten des Vorhabens vorgesehen. Zudem wird der/die Trainee bei Bedarf die Umsetzung in weiteren Vorhaben im Bereich Privatsektor- und Finanzsektorentwicklung unterstützen, v.a. in den Themenbereichen Nachhaltige Finanzierung, Förderung von KMU in grünen Sektoren und in der Kreislaufwirtschaft. Ihre Aufgaben Ihre Aufgaben Als EZ-Trainee In Der Ersten Praxisphase Mitarbeit an der konzeptionellen Entwicklung von Aktivitäten in den einzelnen Komponenten des Vorhabens Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung von Capacity Development Maßnahmen für Umsetzungspartner (Unternehmen, Kammern, staatlichen KMU Agenturen) Beteiligung an der Planung und Umsetzung konkreter Projektaktivitäten im Aufgabenbereich, inkl. Unterstützung bei der Planung und Durchführung größerer Workshops und Veranstaltungen mit Partnern Austausch und Kommunikation mit Partnern, anderen Vorhaben der deutschen EZ und internationalen Gebern Vorhabenübergreifende Mitarbeit bei der Umsetzung weiterer Vorhaben im Themengebiet Die beiden sich anschließenden Praxisphasen und die dortigen Aufgaben werden im Verlauf des EZ-Traineeprogramms entwickelt. Ihr Profil Diese fachlichen Qualifikationen bringen Sie als Trainee für die erste Praxisphase mit: Studium der Wirtschafts- oder Sozialwissenschaften (Master oder vergleichbarer Abschluss) Fachlicher Schwerpunkt des Studiums in VWL, BWL, Politikwissenschaft, Internationale Zusammenarbeit, oder verwandte Studiengänge Notwendige fachliche Kenntnisse im Bereich KKMU-Förderung, Zugang zu Finanzierung für KKMU, Wertschöpfungskettenförderung, Außenwirtschaftsförderung Fließende Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch, Englisch und Französisch Folgende Kenntnisse Und Erfahrungen Runden Ihre Qualifikationen Ab Kenntnisse im Bereich der Entwicklungszusammenarbeit Erste praktische Erfahrungen in einem Entwicklungsland Bereitschaft zu mehrfachen Standortwechseln im Rahmen des Traineeprogramms Offen für Einsätze in unterschiedlichen Organisationen und institutionellen Kontexten Interkulturelle Kompetenz Die Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen in Form eines Praktikums reichen aus. Standortinformationen Jedes GIZ Büro vor Ort hat ein Sicherheitsrisikomanagement benannt. Mitarbeitende der GIZ haben den Vorgaben zu Sicherheitsmaßnahmen jeder Zeit Folge zu leisten. Bitte informieren Sie sich über landesspezifische Hinweise des Auswärtigen Amts. Wir bitten Sie, sich gegebenenfalls zu informieren, welche Beziehungsformen im Einsatzland rechtlich und gesellschaftlich akzeptiert sind. Weitere Informationen zu Senegal erhalten Sie hier . Hinweise Wir erwarten fließende Deutschkenntnisse und bitten Sie, das Anschreiben und den Lebenslauf in deutscher Sprache einzureichen. Bitte haben Sie dafür Verständnis, dass wir Bewerbungen grundsätzlich nur über unser E-Recruiting-System annehmen und bearbeiten können. Sollte Ihnen dies nicht möglich sein, so können Sie gerne die in der Stellenanzeige angegebene Person ansprechen. Bitte prüfen Sie nach dem Abschicken Ihrer Bewerbung, dass Sie eine automatisch generierte Eingangsbestätigung erhalten haben. Überprüfen Sie bitte regelmäßig Ihren Spam/Junk-Ordner in Ihrem Posteingang, da die E-Mails unseres E-Recruiting Systems von manchen Providern als Spam eingestuft werden. Die GIZ möchte Menschen mit Behinderung bei ihrem Einstieg ins Berufsleben fördern. Daher werden Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung besonders berücksichtigt. Auf die 18 EZ-Traineestellen erwarten wir ca. 1.500 Bewerbungen. Wir versuchen die Vorauswahl bis Weihnachten abzuschließen. Bitte haben Sie Geduld, jede/r Bewerber*in erhält bis spätestens Ende Dezember eine Information, ob er/sie in der engeren Auswahl ist. Über uns Absolventinnen und Absolventen des EZ-Traineeprogramms arbeiten in verschiedenen deutschen und multilateralen Organisationen der Entwicklungszusammenarbeit.

Manage the snagging and punch-list process, including inspections, categorisation and assignment of items, progress tracking, and verification of close-out. Plan and coordinate partial and phased handovers, and manage the interfaces between construction, testing and commissioning, and operations activities. Ensure that training of the client's operations and maintenance staff is planned, delivered, and documented as part of the handover requirements. Strong command of QA/QC documentation, handover procedures, and defects liability period management. Recognised commissioning or project management certification (e.g., CxA, PMP) is an advantage. Fluency in Arabic, with strong English communication and stakeholder management skills

review_candidates.description: Hertfordshire Constabulary Police Staff Permanent Full Time ICT Headquarters, Huntingdon, Cambs , Headquarters, WGC, Herts A4 £32,613 37 A great opportunity has arisen to join a growing support team as an ICT Senior Service Desk Analyst within the BCH (Beds, Cambs & Herts) ICT Department. Join the exciting and dynamic world of policing and contribute towards making Bedfordshire, Cambridgeshire and Hertfordshire a safer place. Based at Hertfordshire Constabulary HQ or Cambridgeshire Constabulary, you will play a key role within the ICT Operations Team, supporting the tri-force ICT estate and ensuring that vital business systems remain highly available to officers and staff. About The Role As a Senior Service Desk Analyst, you will provide first-line ICT support while also taking on additional responsibility for supporting and guiding a team of five analysts. You will act as an escalation point for more complex or non-standard issues, helping to drive service quality and improve first-time fix rates. You will use your technical knowledge and customer service skills to diagnose hardware, software and communication issues reported via phone or self-service. Where resolution is not possible at first contact, you will ensure incidents are accurately logged, fully documented, and escalated within agreed SLAs, maintaining clear communication with users throughout. You will also contribute to continuous improvement by maintaining knowledge base articles and coaching the development of colleagues across the Service Desk. Why Join BCH ICT? Bedfordshire, Cambridgeshire and Hertfordshire Police form one of the largest and most established collaborations in the UK. This role offers a fantastic opportunity to develop your career within a supportive and forward-thinking ICT environment, with exposure to a diverse technology estate and opportunities to build leadership experience. Employee Benefits 25 days annual leave, rising to 29 after 5 years’ service (plus public holidays) Competitive Local Government Pension Scheme Access to on-site gym facilities at HQ locations Hybrid working arrangements Blue Light Card discounts Sports and social club membership Employee Assistance Programme Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Everyone at Bedfordshire, Cambridgeshire and Hertfordshire takes personal responsibility to help create an inclusive workplace, where police officers and staff respect one another, feel valued for their differences and can be themselves. We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments, wherever needed so everyone feels welcome and can flourish. We are working hard to continue to enhance and increase our diversity across the three forces, where communities are under-represented, including those from Black, Asian and Minority Ethnic communities, people of all ages, abilities, faiths, religions and gender, LGBT communities and those from other disadvantaged or marginalised backgrounds, who share our values and wish to make a difference to the communities we serve. All applications will be treated on merit, based on the evidence provided in your application and your suitability for the role for which you have applied. We are a Disability Confident employer offering a guaranteed interview scheme for all candidates with a disability covered by the Equality Act 2010 who meet the minimum entry requirements. Should you require any reasonable adjustments for your application process, please contact the HR Recruitment Centre on 01438 757 777. Flexible Working BCH supports agile and flexible working wherever possible. All requests will be considered in line with operational requirements. Police Barred and Advisory lists Individuals placed on the Police Barred and Advisory lists will not be considered for employment by the police for a minimum of 5 years from the date of listing in the case of gross misconduct, or 3 years from the date of listing in the case of poor performance. Vetting and Safeguarding BCH are committed to safeguarding and operate safer recruitment processes, to ensure a police service that employees are proud to work for because they feel safe, valued and part of a happy and supportive work environment. All employees and volunteers therefore will be subject to background checks including vetting and references. Please be aware the Police Corporate Vetting Unit will undertake security vetting on successful candidates, their family and others that live at their home address, which will include financial checks. How To Apply If you are successful, you will be joining one of the most accomplished policing collaborations in the UK where our vision for the future of BCH Policing is exhibited daily across the full breadth of capabilities and functions we deliver. Please Submit Your CV Along With Evidence of your relevant skills and experience A 500-word statement demonstrating how you meet the minimum entry requirements For further information, please contact Jamie Read (BCH Operations, ICT Service Desk Team Leader) via Jamie.Read@cambs.police.uk Additional Advert Information Internal Applicants To apply for this role, internal applicants must have successfully completed their probationary period. If you qualify as an internal candidate within the advertising force, you may upload either your CV or the internal role summary form attached to this advert. Vetting Process Please note that, as part of the vetting process, the BCH Vetting Unit may need to contact your current line manager for a Supervisor Appraisal. This requirement aligns with the 2025 National Guidelines for Vetting (APP 6.5.18). Examples Of When This May Apply Include Transferring to another force Renewing vetting clearance Moving into a role requiring MV clearance (even if you currently hold MV clearance) Moving into or working in a role involving close contact with vulnerable individuals If any of the above apply to you, please expect your line manager to be contacted when you submit your vetting application. Redeployment and Redundancy This vacancy is open to employees at risk of redundancy and will remain available to redeployees until a final offer has been agreed and accepted. Redeployees at risk of redundancy will take priority over all other applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. If successful, redeployees will remain on their home force’s terms and conditions. Role Profile We recommend downloading and saving a copy of the role profile, as it will no longer be accessible once the advert closes. Commitment to Inclusion As a Disability Confident Leader, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and able to be themselves. We provide workplace adjustments wherever needed so that all colleagues can thrive. If you have a disability and meet the minimum criteria for the role, you will be guaranteed an interview under the Offer an Interview Scheme.

Ausgebildet wird für Organisationen der deutschen und multilateralen Entwicklungszusammenarbeit (EZ) . Das Programm wird von der Deutschen Gesellschaft für internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) im Auftrag des BMZ durchgeführt. Im Fokus des Programms stehen die Erweiterung von Managementkompetenzen und der Erwerb von Arbeitserfahrung in Programmbildung und Steuerung der deutschen EZ. Der Aufbau des Programms ermöglicht Ihnen Strukturen, Akteure und Funktionsweisen der EZ in einem Training „on the Job“ aus verschiedenen Perspektiven kennenzulernen. Während der 17-monatigen Ausbildung durchlaufen Sie drei Praxisphasen . Nach der 1-monatigen Vorbereitung starten Sie mit dem 8-monatigen Einsatz in der o.g. Funktion und dem genannten Land. Anschließend wählen Sie einen 3-monatigen Einsatz bei einer internationalen Organisation und enden mit einem 5-monatigen Einsatz im BMZ. Die Traineevergütung beträgt 2.600,- € brutto/Monat. Weitere Informationen zum EZ-Traineeprogramm finden Sie auf den Internetseiten des BMZ und der GIZ Tätigkeitsbereich Im Rahmen des Traineeprogramms werden Sie für Ihren 8-monatigen Einsatz im GIZ Vorhaben Invest in Senegal, Dakar eingesetzt. Das Vorhaben zielt darauf ab, das Wachstum und die Investitionstätigkeit von senegalesischen und in Senegal tätigen europäischen Unternehmen zu erhöhen. Dazu werden konkrete Unternehmenspartnerschaften zwischen senegalesischen und deutschen und europäischen Unternehmen umgesetzt und eine Servicestelle Wirtschaft als zentrale Anlaufstelle für deutsche/europäische Unternehmen in Senegal etabliert. Lokale kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU) mit Wachstumspotenzial werden in strategischen Wertschöpfungsketten unterstützt, um ihre Wettbewerbsfähigkeit zu erhöhen, lokale Zulieferketten zu stärken und die Einbindung lokaler KMU in nationale und internationale Märkte zu stärken. Zudem legt das Vorhaben einen besonderen Fokus auf den Zugang zu Finanzierung für KMU. Hierzu werden KMU bei der Vorbereitung und Beantragung geeigneter Finanzierungsinstrumente unterstützt und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Beratungs- und Finanzinstitutionen gestärkt. Die Online Plattform Guichet Unique de Financement des PME (GUF-PME) dient dabei als zentrales Instrument, um KMU bedarfsgerecht mit Beratungs- und Finanzierungsangeboten zu vernetzen, Finanzierungsanfragen an geeignete Finanzinstitutionen zu vermitteln und den Finanzierungsprozess effizienter zu gestalten. Der EZ-Traineeeinsatz ist in allen Komponenten des Vorhabens vorgesehen.
